appearance: Dry night race; qualifying and introductions also include twilight.
terrain_character: Beige desert, modest rising and falling infield, almost no continuous tree walls.
distinctive_geometry: Sakhir Tower: layered circular cream floor plates, dark wraparound glazing, red night bands, small central upper crown.
Main Grandstand: long rising spectator tiers under repeated white pointed tensile sails; steel edge masts, open underside.
Pit hospitality: repeating smaller sail roofs above two-storey garages.

sectors.name: Pit straight and T1–3
sectors.observed: Left main grandstand and first-turn stand; right long white pit/hospitality and Sakhir Tower. Red-white kerbs, broad coloured paved T1 escape, sand beyond. Keep braking 150/100/50 boards before T1 and protection behind runoff.
sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.name: T3 climb, first back straight and T4
sectors.observed: University stands outside opening sequence, sandy banks, fenced dry infield. Broad outer asphalt at T4, narrow inner red-white kerb, green and blue painted shoulders. Floodlight heads remain visible above the horizon.
sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.name: T5–8 linked infield bends

sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.name: T9–10 downhill left braking

sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.name: Inner straight and T11
sectors.observed: Batelco spectator structure is right of inner straight near station2790. Straight Armco/mesh protection, beige dry expanse, asphalt escape at left-hand entry. Keep stand geometry above wall visible.
sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.name: T12–13 fast right rise
sectors.observed: Open rising sandy ground, red-white inside kerb and coloured paved outside transition. Track floodlighting, low guardrail/tyre backing rather than roadside buildings on both sides.
sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.name: Back straight and final right T14–15
sectors.observed: Long open straight toward white pointed canopy cluster; Victory stands outside final bend. Red-white apex, wide dark/blue-green escape with sand behind; lamps on both sides. Preserve long braking sightline.
sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

sectors.registration: Direct retained frames registered by HUD, minimap, road handedness and fixed landmarks; native ranges remain approximate authoring sectors. A frame supports its visible corner, not every metre in the containing sector. No elapsed-time station interpolation.

dimensions_policy: OSM XY footprints are registered geographic evidence. Tagged height and levels are retained verbatim; missing/zero heights are unknown. Roof/detail sizes and sparse-vegetation spacing in native authoring are visual estimates pending cockpit comparison.

source_registration.method: Nearest native centerline sample after retained local tangent projection and uniform scale.
source_registration.landmark_extent_note: Centroid station can fall on adjacent arm of circuit; use actual ring and terrain, not centroid station alone. Overlapping compound roof footprints must never become solid road obstructions.

elevation_review.status: Canonical operator-constrained local ramps are ready for root native synchronization and cockpit review.
findings: Retained GLO-90 profile has 19.736 m relief; operator gives 18 m. These are different accuracy levels, not permission to stretch individual crests arbitrarily.
Default generic shoulders miss large blue/green/red painted asphalt escape areas and their sand outside.

replacement_profile.vertical_datum: Relative to the published profile minimum; absolute diagram altitude is not used.
replacement_profile.interpolation: Piecewise monotone cubic Hermite. Interior Fritsch-Carlson harmonic slopes; flat SF seam. No uniform rescaling of the previous DEM.
replacement_profile.method: Read relative heights from the published numerical extremum labels and drawn trace, then register individual official corners to retained native centerline geometry using FIA maps. Intermediate heights are graphical estimates, not measurements.
replacement_profile.registration_notes: The old GLO-90 maximum was near T13. The operator and F1 diagram identify T4 as the summit. F1 gives 16.9 m relief, while the operator rounds the venue relief to18m. Relative heights only; the chart absolute sea-level datum is not used.
replacement_profile.supersedes: Coarse GLO-90 road profile remains retained as source evidence, not as the racing deck. No new lidar or survey is claimed.

operator_grade_corrections.source_conflict: F 1 gives 16.9 m relative relief; the operator rounds this to 18 m. Preserve 16.9 m rather than scale the whole lap. The old unconstrained Hermite ramps reached 3.90% after T2 and 4.86% before T12, above the more specific operator maximum.
operator_grade_corrections.method: Spread the climb through the observed road approach instead of adding a steep cubic bulge between sparse graphical labels. T11 and T12 heights stay within 1 m of the earlier graphical estimates; the highest T4 anchor and other sectors are unchanged.
operator_grade_corrections.survey_status: Local ramp positions and intermediate heights are estimates constrained by primary metric bounds, not a civil survey.

required: Cockpit contact sheet covering all sectors, including each landmark approach and both road edges.
No floating tiles, barriers crossing drivable lane, closed escape mouths, or faceted long curves.
Compare curb colour/extent, runoff surface/depth, fencing, tree placement and skyline per sector against timestamps.
Review night illumination for asphalt visibility and dark sky, or daylight landscape contrast as appropriate.
acceptance.status: Reference inventory and scene recipe authored; native runtime acceptance is separate.

authored_edges.side_convention: Numeric+1 is driver right, -1 is driver left. Shader runoff widths clamp to exported collision shoulders.
authored_edges.registration: Intervals visually estimated against mapped native curves and supplied video; not a surveyed curb or safety-installation trace.
authored_edges.physical_escape_review: Large terminal escape mouths still need explicit footprint geometry and matching collision-barrier changes. Surface ribbons must not extend through existing collision walls.

native_scene_status: Authored geometry and type checks complete. Native cockpit review and collision acceptance are pending.
scenery_grounding: Mapped buildings use the lowest footprint terrain level. Stand fronts have retaining bases and rear supports extend to sampled terrain. Trees avoid all road arms and mapped building footprints.

additional_authoritative_data.title: Survey and Land Registration Bureau DTM service

source_conflicts: Retained city footprints can cross the modeled road corridor. Native facade authoring clips ground walls outside the road mask plus 1.2 m and records the removed area; these are disclosed registration conflicts, not validated building surveys.

barrier_branding.coordinate_frame: Native source station metres; numerical +1 is driver right and -1 is driver left.
barrier_branding.artwork: Original typeset event panels with observed identity and palette; no video pixels or extracted game textures are shipped.
barrier_branding.registration: Wall identities are visible in the listed sparse reference frames. Native intervals are estimated from corner and landmark registration, with approximately 75 m endpoint uncertainty; edited playback is not treated as a linear station clock.
barrier_branding.unbranded_sections: Retain bare Armco and concrete outside these explicit bands. Unsupported legible identities are left without a substitute sponsor. A sponsor bridge alone is not evidence for a matching roadside band.

apron_paint_review.reviewed: Overview and detailed frames across the lap; specific added motifs are tied to the listed frame timestamps. Paint registration is estimated from official corners and landmarks, not proportional playback time.
apron_paint_review.geometry: Original vector shapes, road-branch height with sample=scene.at(station), clipped away from the road. No reference pixels shipped.

apron_paint_review.native_changes: No corridor extent or physical surface-class changes.
apron_paint_review.unpainted_policy: Gravel, grass and unpainted asphalt remain beyond the observed paint bands.

observed.name: Bahrain floodlight recipe
observed.structure: 30–32 m straight multi-head masts in open sectors; 24 m canted pit-front banks. Individual positions, heights and 50–55 m spacing are visual estimates.
observed.confidence: High for bank versus streetlamp distinction; moderate for sector distribution; low for metric dimensions. Relative field powers are rendering parameters, not photometry.

night_lighting.render_power: Dimensionless estimates for diffuse-field calibration, not measured watts or lumens. Every optical center retains its own base-ground elevation.
night_lighting.pit_lane_clearance: Roof-mounted pit-side banks/supports remain above the authored roof, with field ground_z tied to native road/garage ground. Other fixed masts are set beyond garage rear depth, not placed in the pit lane when native shoulder is narrowed to0.10m.
